body.p: After . As 2.19 and 4.17, over the XSD contributor groups and then the schema-aware QT4 and XSLT sets. Each sweep claims its files in docs/LOG.md. Sweep 1 done 2026-10-18 (): 's QT4 outcome rules removed and their cases fixed (group by tuples, leaf predicates in the filter task); validation descriptions that name what failed; configured schema documents located by the library; one XPath record compiler; src-redefine 6.2.2 and 7.2.2, open content and empty content, override defaults, simple bases in the registry, year -0000, src-ct, wildcard subset. XSD in scope 41,483 of 41,518, XP40 30,931, XQ40 41,273 (0 errors), XT40 7,992. Sweep 2 done 2026-10-18 (): XT40's six errors cleared at their causes (built-in types restated by the schema for schema documents, the stand-in xml.xsd only without another document of the namespace, invalid sources judged as the transformation's error); validate-items a row of its own (sxml.wasm in budget); xslt.h's in_scope_schemas comment accepted. XT40 8,650 (0 errors), XP40 30,931, XQ40 41,273, XSD 41,483. Sweep 3 done 2026-10-20 (): the 32 XSD11 failures by cause, 21 fixed by XSD 1.1's rules (src-attribute.5, src-redefine.1, attribute types, required uses in restrictions, simple content of xs:anySimpleType, fixed values as values, Element Declarations Consistent with wildcards, wildcard unions, xml:lang), 11 left as 1.0 rules or disputed; content recovery after cvc-complex-type.2.4; no xsi:schemaLocation in the CLI (the library follows no hints). XSD 41,507 of 41,518; schema-aware XQ40 and XT40 sets unchanged.
